title: tell
sub: Who's hiring for the problem you solve?

bullets.text: Linked 312 SEC Form D raises to each filer's own website using public data only, 38 of 38 hand-checked links correct (95% lower bound 0.91): required the site to state the exact legal name, or brand plus filing city, then linked by CIK.

Found 14.8% of 2,625 open postings on 129 YC job boards had been open 180+ days, and 57% of boards with dated roles held at least one: fingerprinted every requisition so hiring signals count only fresh, unique openings.

Deployed 6 collectors (4 job-board APIs, SEC EDGAR, news) on a 4x/day GitHub Actions cron with Neon Postgres and a static JSON API at $0/month: sha256 event IDs make reruns insert 0 rows, and CI replays every collector twice to prove it.
